Booked through us

Benefits that come with every stay

Through our partnerships with the world's best hotels and resorts, your booking carries extras you do not get when booking direct. Each proposal lists exactly what applies.

Hotel credit

Many of our hotels add a US$100 credit, or its equivalent, to each stay.

Daily breakfast for two

Buffet, à la carte or in-room, depending on the hotel.

Room upgrade

One category up at or before check-in, subject to availability.

Welcome amenity

A personal welcome from the hotel's management when you arrive.

Early check-in, late check-out

Preferred-guest status gives you more flexibility when the hotel can offer it.

Your loyalty points

We book directly with the hotel, so your stay still earns points, nights and status.

How it works

Choose how you want us to help

Free

Hotel booking

A stay at a hotel or resort, at the hotel's own rate with our benefits added.

  1. Tell us the hotel or destination and your dates.
  2. Receive a written proposal within 24 hours, with the rate and the benefits.
  3. Confirm, and we book directly with the hotel.

No added cost to you.

Request a hotel quote
Free

Cruise booking

A cruise on a leading cruise line, at the line's own fare, with our support from first question to boarding.

  1. Tell us the ship or destination, your dates and who travels.
  2. Receive a written proposal within 24 hours, with the fare and what is included.
  3. Confirm, and we book directly with the cruise line.

No added cost to you.

Request a cruise quote
For a fee

Travel itinerary

A day-by-day plan for your whole trip, prepared by us.

  1. Tell us where, when and who is travelling.
  2. Talk with an advisor; time is included according to the length of your trip.
  3. Receive your complete itinerary.

The fee is confirmed before you pay.

Request a travel itinerary
For a fee

Gastrotrip

A restaurant itinerary built around the MICHELIN Guide and The World's 50 Best Restaurants.

  1. Choose your cities, dates, meals and cuisine.
  2. Pay with PayPal; the price is shown before you pay.
  3. Receive your itinerary by e-mail within 48 hours.

Fixed price by length of trip, shown before you pay.

      Gastrotrip

      A journey shaped around the table

      What your Gastrotrip includes

      • A day-by-day plan for each city, with suggested lunches and dinners.
      • For each restaurant: MICHELIN or 50 Best recognition, cuisine, distance from your hotel and price range.
      • When bookings open and how to reserve, with contact details.
      • Adaptation to your dietary restrictions.
      • A backup option for each meal.
      • What to order and the dress code.
      • Time with an advisor to adjust your plan: up to 30, 60 or 90 minutes by trip length.
      • Delivered as a PDF by e-mail within 48 hours.
